instruction: Fix `parse_ini` in `parselib/ini.py` so keys are stored under their section instead of being flattened into the top level. The current code always writes `result[key]`, so section keys and top-level keys collide and section headers are effectively ignored.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib/ini.py b/parselib/ini.py
--- a/parselib/ini.py
+++ b/parselib/ini.py
@@ -26,5 +26,6 @@
         if pair is None:
             continue
         key, value = pair
-        result[key] = value
+        target = result if section is None else result[section]
+        target[key] = value
     return result
